title: The R9.99 fee that costs R360 a year #MoneyTransfer
text:
Sending money from one Shoprite or Checkers counter to another costs a flat R9.99 on top of the money you send. Flat means the same fee whatever you send: on R200 it's about 5%, on R2,000 only half a percent. Lerato (an illustration) sends her mother R200 four times a month: four fees, almost R40. Send R800 once a month instead: one fee, about R10. That's about R30 a month back in her pocket, R360 a year, for the same money sent.

Full guide: "How Shoprite Makes Money: R6 of Every R100 (and Why It's in Every Town)" on the Money From Zero channel.
